children: SpaceX and Tesla formed special committees to discuss a possible merger, Elon Musk said on an earnings call. Barclays estimates Musk could hold 37% of combined equity and 56% of voting power.
SPCX agreed to acquire 65 MHz of spectrum licenses from EchoStar and secured additional spectrum, potentially boosting range and indoor coverage for its planned mobile service.
SpaceX’s data center capacity could reach 13 GW by 2027, up from its 10 GW target, SemiAnalysis says. It identified over 9 GW at planned sites, including 3.6 GW under construction.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) announced a $40 billion chip deal in October, backed by Apollo Global Management financing reportedly costlier than for similarly rated borrowers.
SPCX is accelerating data center builds: MiniHard took five months, while its Southaven site targets four. Project SPAM began construction last month, with computing systems due online in December.
House Democrats called for probes into SpaceX’s federal contracts and Elon Musk’s role at the Office of Personnel Management while leading DOGE. NASA and the Defense Department are SpaceX customers.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) has secured billions in U.S. government contracts since President Trump began his second term, including Space Force awards extending through 2030.
A transaction could give SpaceX access to Boost Mobile’s 7 million-plus wireless customers and billing system as it enters the U.S. mobile market.
Musk and Sequoia Capital’s Shaun Maguire said Starship could make orbital computing practical by lowering launch costs for heavy equipment, including chip-cooling systems.
A consultant said SpaceX (SPCX) could seek EchoStar’s remaining business in a share-based deal involving wireless assets and spectrum. No agreement has been announced.
